visual:1.note: Offer card layout: the Design puts the question 「The characters look great! Ready to create the storyboard?」 inside an outer card above the blue action card; the app draws the question as a plain chat line outside the card (outer card starts below it).
visual:1.note_zh: 提議卡版面：Design 把問題「The characters look great! Ready to create the storyboard?」放在藍色動作卡上方的外框卡內；App 把問題畫成卡片外的一般對話行（外框卡從其下方開始）。

visual:2.note: The app adds the line 「Credits will be consumed for this task.」 under the card title; the Design has no such line, so the card is taller.
visual:2.note_zh: App 在卡片標題下多了「Credits will be consumed for this task.」；Design 沒有這一行，卡片因此較高。

visual:3.note: The Design shows the 「Create storyboard」 card right under Characters Result; in the app it came only after typing 「Create storyboard」, with 「The language is already set to English.」 and 「I have created the six-beat storyboard…」 in between, before any storyboard exists (Android DRA262610P0268, TC-440).
visual:3.note_zh: Design 在 Characters Result 下方直接顯示「Create storyboard」卡；App 要手動輸入「Create storyboard」後才出現，中間還有「The language is already set to English.」與「I have created the six-beat storyboard…」，而分鏡尚未產生（Android DRA262610P0268，TC-440）。

padding:I2778:128654;2750:64270.note: Fine: the box measured here is the whole message card, not a box around this text. Inside the blue card the title keeps Design's inset (about 13 pt from the left and top edges); the extra distance comes from the app's added line 「Credits will be consumed for this task.」 and the question sitting above the card, which change the card's height, not its padding.
padding:I2778:128654;2750:64270.note_zh: 沒問題：此處量的是整張訊息卡，不是包住這段文字的框。藍色卡片內標題與邊緣的距離與 Design 相同（左、上約 13 pt）；多出的距離來自 App 多一行「Credits will be consumed for this task.」且問句放在卡片上方，改變的是卡片高度，不是內距。

padding:I2778:128654;2750:64276.note: Fine: the credit cost sits at the bottom of the blue card with about the same bottom inset as Design (within 3 pt); its larger distance from the card top comes from the app's added line 「Credits will be consumed for this task.」, not from a padding change. The number itself is sample content.
padding:I2778:128654;2750:64276.note_zh: 沒問題：扣點數字位於藍色卡片底部，與底緣距離和 Design 相近（差 3 pt 內）；與卡片頂端距離較大是因為 App 多一行「Credits will be consumed for this task.」，不是內距改變。數字本身是範例內容。

padding:I2778:128654;2750:64323;2750:253.note: Not a padding problem: the 「Generate」 button uses the same 16 pt side padding as Design; it is narrower only because Roboto Bold draws 「Generate」 about 5 pt narrower than SF Pro. Same button on every credit card.
padding:I2778:128654;2750:64323;2750:253.note_zh: 不是內距問題：「Generate」按鈕左右內距與 Design 同為 16 pt，只因 Roboto Bold 畫出的「Generate」比 SF Pro 窄約 5 pt，按鈕才較窄。所有扣點卡片上的按鈕都一樣。

padding:I2778:128661;1037:48645;245:2027.note: The credit pill is tighter than Design: Design pads it 12 pt on both sides with a 16 pt credit icon and a 4 pt gap, so the number starts 32 pt from the left edge and ends 12 pt from the right; the app uses 9 pt start and 10 pt end padding and a 14 pt icon, so the number sits about 6 pt nearer the left edge and 2 pt nearer the right. The balance number itself is sample content; the padding and icon size are not. Same pill on every chat screen, dark and light.
padding:I2778:128661;1037:48645;245:2027.note_zh: 點數膠囊比 Design 緊：Design 左右內距各 12 pt、點數圖示 16 pt、間距 4 pt，所以數字距左緣 32 pt、距右緣 12 pt；App 起始內距 9 pt、結尾 10 pt、圖示 14 pt，數字離左緣近約 6 pt、離右緣近約 2 pt。餘額數字本身是範例內容，內距與圖示大小不是。所有聊天畫面（深色與淺色）的點數膠囊都一樣。
